notices: Actual unmodified author bodies registered rigidly to the fixed frame, with real VORON native screws/inserts/T-nuts. No generic spool or invented purchased geometry.
Three original roller halves are rigidly phased 180deg about their unchanged bearing axes to align the original screw/insert patterns.
Actual upper-guide stack requires a real M5x16 for modeled engagement; staged bill differs from author literal two M5x16/two M5x10: three M5x16 and the original lower M5x10.
Author-permitted roller BHCS bears on its native circular edge, not a flat annular seat. Strength, preload, heat-insert manufacture and filament route are not certified.
Reference frame/stock brace/source straight solid PTFE excluded; no built-in print supports removed.

The original lower guide, original M5x10 screw and real M5 T-nut are rigidly mounted on the inner side slot of the right rear 2020 corner post. Holder and guides only; no spool or registered filament route.

The original tilted upper guide, real M5x16 screw and real M5 T-nut are rigidly mounted 100 mm to the right in the underside slot of the rear top 2020 bar, beside the stock exhaust grill. The original roof, foam and clips remain unchanged. No filament route is registered.
